purpose: New executable source-level repair cases for later time-to-verified-repair measurement. Cross-function structure is a design descriptor, not established human hardness; no guaranteed speedup or assistant benefit is claimed.
authorship: Codex-authored fixture candidates and protected tests; no external model, independent review agent, V4 assistant output or trial participant consulted during corpus construction.
oracle_policy: Private mutations, pinned reference restoration, mechanism labels and investigation/repair invariants are evaluator-only. Participant manifests and model evidence contain only neutral test selectors/broad production roots or observed logs/source, never these metadata.
candidate_retention_policy: Every proof attempt is retained with its exact catalog and lab snapshot, including ineffective seeds or baseline/test mistakes. Final executable status does not erase earlier failed candidates.
split_policy: Two development cases, six sealed evaluation cases, four separately reserved timed-repair cases, two controls. Reserved cases never enter machine evaluation or prompt selection.
difficulty_policy: Several production functions/files and protected neighboring checks provide opportunities for investigation. Structural complexity does not establish human difficulty or equal difficulty between trials.

cases.private_mechanism: Timeout outcomes remain distinct from provider errors while fallback still executes
cases.regression_tests:
from decilist import Decilist, FunctionProvider, Policy
@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw,expected",[({"a":.5,"b":.5},"low_confidence"),({"a":.1,"b":.1},"invalid_output"),({"a":True,"b":False},"invalid_output")])
async def test_neighboring_provider_records(raw,expected):
    engine=Decilist([FunctionProvider(lambda _:raw,name="first"),FunctionProvider(lambda _:{"a":1,"b":0},name="second")])
    result=await engine.choose("observed","Select",{"a":"A","b":"B"})
    assert result.value == "a"
    assert [a.outcome for a in result.attempts] == [expected,"accepted"]
    strict=await engine.choose("observed","Select",{"a":"A","b":"B"},policy=Policy(min_confidence=1.0))
    assert strict.status == "accepted" and strict.confidence == 1

cases.private_mechanism: Multipart boundary extraction must agree with the serialized entity
cases.case_tests:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("boundary,quoted",[("alpha-one",False),("beta-two",True),("gamma-333",False)])
def test_request_records(boundary,quoted):
    captured=[]
    def handle(request):
        captured.append(request)
        return httpx.Response(200)
    token='"'+boundary+'"' if quoted else boundary
    with httpx.Client(transport=httpx.MockTransport(handle),trust_env=False) as client:
        client.post("https://example.test/upload",headers={"content-type":"multipart/form-data; boundary="+token},data={"tag":["one","two"]},files={"file":("data.txt",b"body","text/plain")})
    request=captured[0]
    assert request.content.startswith(b"--"+boundary.encode()+b"\r\n")
    assert request.content.endswith(b"--"+boundary.encode()+b"--\r\n")
    assert request.content.count(b'name="tag"') == 2
    assert b'filename="data.txt"' in request.content and b"body" in request.content
    assert int(request.headers["content-length"]) == len(request.content)
cases.regression_tests:
@pytest.mark.parametrize("file",[b"simple",b"",b"a\r\nb"])
def test_neighboring_request_records(file):
    request=httpx.Request("POST","https://example.test/upload",files={"file":("data.bin",file,"application/custom",{"X-Part":"kept"})})
    body=request.read()
    boundary=request.headers["content-type"].split("boundary=",1)[1].encode()
    assert body.startswith(b"--"+boundary+b"\r\n") and body.endswith(b"--"+boundary+b"--\r\n")
    assert b"Content-Type: application/custom" in body and b"X-Part: kept" in body
    assert int(request.headers["content-length"]) == len(body)
